named_semantics: the selector defaults to zero when an existing profile does not define it
the Doom demo menu item and its menu action are not selected
doompad, doominput, and doominputmux handlers and command-table entries are not selected
general help, command metadata, video metadata, and video status do not advertise the removed commands or video Doom

after an argc check and pure command-table lookup, an exact lowercase video demo doom prefix is rejected before busy policy, protocol-generic dispatch, command logging, HUD stop, command handler execution, timing, or command-end reaping
the direct shell, cmdv1, and successfully decoded cmdv1x paths all enter the same early rejection
the internal cmd_video_demo rejection calls the same video_demo_doom_removed helper
video_demo_doom_removed prints video.demo.doom=removed plus non-Doom usage and returns -ENOTSUP

neither operational nor inert Doom bridge source is selected, and bridge objects, global symbols, undefined symbols, and call relocations are zero
allowed_effects: marker, non-Doom usage, console result, and requested protocol framing bytes written through a90_console_printf and write_all to the already-bound console_fd
in-memory protocol sequence increment for cmdv1 and cmdv1x
capability_execution_critical_closure.existing_console_fd_boundary: The capability does not open, create, select, or redirect a console sink. If the already-bound console_fd references any sink, writing the intended console bytes to that existing descriptor is the explicitly allowed console effect.
excluded_effects: process creation, signaling, wait, or cleanup
file open, creation, redirect, pidfile cleanup, or menu IPC cleanup
audio, socket, Doom bridge, payload, partition, flash, or other device effect

protocol_path_audit.pure_lookup: a90_shell_find_command only iterates the command table and compares names
protocol_path_audit.direct_shell: execute_shell_command receives video demo doom with protocol_v1=false and returns through the early helper
protocol_path_audit.cmdv1: shell_loop removes the cmdv1 wrapper and calls execute_shell_command with protocol_v1=true; only protocol sequence, protocol console framing, helper console output, last-result bookkeeping, and console result output occur
protocol_path_audit.cmdv1x: a90_cmdproto_decode_v1x validates and decodes into caller-owned memory without I/O, then shell_loop calls the same protocol_v1=true execution path
protocol_path_audit.bookkeeping: a90_shell_result_errno and a90_cmdproto_status are pure; a90_shell_save_last_result changes only static in-memory state; a90_shell_print_result and a90_cmdproto_begin/end only format and write console bytes
protocol_path_audit.console_write: a90_console_printf formats into a stack buffer and calls write_all on the existing console_fd; write_all retries write on EINTR and performs no open, redirect, log, cleanup, process, DRM, audio, socket, bridge, reaper, or device operation
protocol_path_audit.prompt_reaper_boundary: The shell-loop reaper at the top of an iteration is prompt housekeeping before a command is read, not part of removed-command dispatch. After the rejection returns, the next shell-loop prompt reaper occurs only in the future loop iteration, outside execute_shell_command, and is not triggered inside the removed-command execution.
